text:
li: Heads up — saw a repeating page-ejection spike in the cache heatmap during mixed-length batching on Qwen-MQA. Long contexts slowly grow resident memory over ~20k tokens. attaching heatmap snapshot and a quick profiler excerpt.

max: Can you paste the heatmap + repro steps? Which kernel was selected (auto vs tiled)?

li: Quick paste:
```
heatmap: layer0..layer30 residency bins
  hot: layers 8-12 (steady)
  migrating: layers 13-20 (bursty every ~7s)
page_eject_rate: 0.0418 ops/s
page_inflight_evictions: 3->7 spikes correlated with long seq flush
mem_rss: 16.3G -> 19.8G over 22k tokens
```
Kernel selector reported: `tiled-attn-opt` for MQA variant on GPU A100.

tara: This smells like stripe-alignment + rounding mismatch. If the kernel switches tiling strategy at certain seq boundaries, it moves the per-layer KV offsets by a few cache pages -> creates holes and forces eviction later.

oliver: Repro steps that hit it locally for me:
```bash
./run_infer --model=qwen-mqa --batch 6 --seq-lens "1024,32,512,2048,8192,4096" --kernel auto --prefix-cache-on
# run for ~40k tokens, observe mem growth
```
Also saw that enabling continuous batching (pack many short into long) amplifies the pattern.

max: Is this Qwen-MQA specific? Did you test Llama / Mistral?

li: Llama shows small transient spikes but no net growth. Mistral shows a mild version of the pattern if you enable GQA emulation, but Qwen-MQA is worst. Hypothesis: MQA packing + kernel tiling causes per-layer buffer rounding to step in larger increments, so reuse becomes misaligned with page boundaries.

tara: Two notes: 1) rope scaling changes per-layer KV length, so when rope scaling crosses the kernel threshold we end up reallocating with different strides. 2) the kernel's batch-sharding step currently picks tiles based on average seq len; mixed sequences cause the kernel to recompose tile plan mid-epoch.

li: Perf snippet from profiler:
```
[profiler] timeline: 00:03:21
kernel_switches: 14 (auto->tiled-attn-opt->fallback)
kv_alloc_round: 4096 -> 6144 bytes alignment on layer 10
page_faults_user: +120 in 1m window
```

perf-bot: perf-alert: memory-growth regression detected on nightly/canary for qwen-mqa (commit b12f3). rss +23% vs baseline on 64k token soak. See: http://perf/reports/171824

max: Actionable items:
- Add guard in kernel-selector to avoid switching tiling mid-batch for MQA models.
- Emit per-layer page-residency histograms in telemetry.
- Reproduce with kernel override (force legacy kernel) to verify regression path.

oliver: I can test kernel override today and run a 24h continuous soak. Also will try compact-on-idle pass (free small holes) to see if fragmentation settles.

tara: I'll sketch a quick PR that disables auto-tiling for MQA when mixed-seq variance > 0.6 and adds an opt-in compaction flag.

li: Thanks. Also please add a short test harness: 8-worker mixed seq generator + prefix cache toggles. We need a deterministic demo to attach to the perf alert.

max: Let's not roll this change to prod until we have canary stability. Hold deploys for Dedicated pools that serve qwen-mqa until mitigations land.

oliver: Ack. I'll upload logs and the heatmap image to the ticket (INF-3412) and share results in ~6h.

li: Uploaded profiler dumps and the heatmap to INF-3412. cc @tara @max

tara: Nice, will review the dumps and open PR with tests. :+1:

perf-bot: noted. Monitoring threshold lowered for qwen-mqa canaries.
